name: What factors drive the overall cost of a kitchen remodel?

mainEntity.name: What factors drive the overall cost of a kitchen remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Kitchen remodel costs vary based on room size, structural modifications, and material choices. Primary cost drivers include cabinetry, which often accounts for 30 to 40 percent of the budget, followed by labor, countertops, and appliances. Modifying load-bearing walls or relocating the sink, dishwasher, or gas line significantly increases plumbing and electrical expenses compared to keeping the existing layout intact. Establishing a realistic scope early helps balance high-end finishes against necessary infrastructure upgrades.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cabinetry, layout changes, structural alterations, and appliance selections drive costs most. Keeping your original plumbing and electrical footprint lowers overall expense.
